# Kam na mši

> Mše svatá poblíž, právě teď. Webová a iOS aplikace, která najde nejbližší katolické
> bohoslužby v České republice podle vaší polohy a seřadí je podle toho, kterou ještě
> stihnete — hned, dnes, zítra nebo v neděli. Pořady bohoslužeb pro zhruba 4 000 kostelů
> a kaplí z oficiálního rejstříku České biskupské konference. Zdarma, bez reklam, bez
> registrace, bez cookies; funguje offline. Česky, s anglickým rozhraním.

## What it is
- A mass finder for Czechia: "which Catholic mass can I still make, when and where".
- Day switcher (now / today / tomorrow / Sunday) works like leafing through the ordo; a map
  with the next mass on each pin (greyed when it is on another day than the one you picked).
- Church detail: weekly schedule, extraordinary services, parish contacts, map / navigation
  link (mapy.cz), shareable URL per church (`/kostel/<id>/`), add-to-calendar (ICS).
- Filters: only Holy Mass, wheelchair access, Greek-Catholic rite, language.
- Offline: the whole dataset (~1.3 MB) is stored on the device; the last location is
  remembered. The iOS app (App Store, "Kam na mši") adds reminders and native sharing.
- Free, no account, no ads, no cookies; only first-party anonymous usage counts.

## How to use it
- https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/ — allow location (or pick a city) and read the list.
- City pages are real URLs, e.g. https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/mesto/praha/ (see the sitemap).
- Church pages: https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/kostel/<id>/
- All Saints (1 Nov) and All Souls / Dušičky (2 Nov): https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/dusicky/ —
  static per-city lists of the services the register gives for those two dates, e.g.
  https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/dusicky/brno/. Church pages carry the two days too in the
  month before.
- Christmas (půlnoční, 24–26 Dec): https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/vanoce/ and per town, e.g.
  https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/vanoce/praha/. Advent dawn Masses (roráty):
  https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/advent/ and per town, e.g. https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/advent/praha/.
  Listed are only services the register or a parish notice gives for those dates; a town or
  church with nothing published says so, with the date we last checked. Never a guessed time.

## Markdown twins (for assistants)
Every /vanoce/ and /advent/ page has a static Markdown twin at the same URL plus `index.md`,
e.g. https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/vanoce/praha/index.md, and the hubs
https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/vanoce/index.md and https://bohosluzby.dravec.org/advent/index.md.
A twin holds more than the page: every service with church, address (town, GPS), time, days,
rite, language, barrier-free access, the date the register entry was last verified, the
source (register or a linked parish notice) and the church page; then every church in the
town with no schedule published yet and where to check. Each twin states when it was built
and the register snapshot date. Only these season pages have twins.

## Data & provenance
- Source: the official register of the Czech Bishops' Conference, https://bohosluzby.cirkev.cz
  — parishes maintain their own entries. The app refreshes the dataset monthly and at the
  start of each liturgical season, and shows "naposledy ověřeno" (last verified) per church.
- Some register entries are old; the app flags stale ones. Before travelling, confirm the time
  with the parish.
